digest.component_or_area: store lock management and compaction sweeps
propositions: A blocked writer cannot identify whether the lock holder is a compaction sweep or determine if interrupting it is safe, receiving only a bare pid in the timeout message.
The compaction sweep operation is documented as interruptible without data loss, but this safety guarantee is not communicated to operators when a lock timeout occurs.
The operation label must reach the lock owner stamp through an ambient mechanism (contextvars) without modifying the acquisition call site in compact_txn.py.
The lock owner stamp must remain colon-free and forward-compatible when an optional op= field is added for the operation label.
The LockTimeout error message must distinguish between labeled interruptible operations (compact-sweep) and ordinary writers, providing a remedy line only for known safe-to-interrupt holders.
The remedy text for a compaction sweep holder must state that interrupting it is lossless and the next trigger will re-fold the events.
